slides.text:
The Takeaway Blueprint
Asexual reproduction relies on mitosis to create identical
diploid clones.
Sexual reproduction requires the fusion of gametes, creating
genetic variation.
Meiosis is a reduction division that halves the chromosome
number to create haploid (n) gametes.
Fertilisation fuses two haploid gametes to restore the
diploid (2n) chromosome number. S
